explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 98 named tracks and releases across Juno's September 15 current and weekly techno feeds, adjacent breakbeat/electro/dub windows, back-catalogue inventory and classics. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: The repaired target state, canonical ledger, journey annotations, active discussions, live revisit queue, rejected state, discoveries, target-local discovery pool and set ideas, publication state and global utility ledger were audited first. UTF-8, JSON, count, annotation and protected-order checks passed; no objective defect, active listener authorization, triggered revisit or open workflow repair required REPAIR.

Every canonical, previously evaluated, active PARKED, placement-specific REJECT and previously unresolved exact artist/title identity was excluded. The current request contains nine fresh exact artist/title leads from nine distinct releases; no ranking slot was filled for resolver convenience.

Repair Run 261's evidence-quality guard was applied: one lead per release. Exact-track prose is identified where available and is not transferred to sibling tracks; limited shared framing is labelled as such.

Individual descriptions remain attributed prose, not measurements. No wording was converted into inferred energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, mixability or transition quality. No placement splits either protected handoff in Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.

Rank reflects evidence specificity, fit hypothesis and information gain rather than novelty, genre orthodoxy, artist diversity, technical cleverness or a fixed chapter map. Sawa and Carried remain removed; Tender Is The Night remains positively retained.
